Destroy module data: Solo

This permanently destroys all data of the module solo. It cannot be undone.

Destroyed:

  • the namespace mod-solo and everything in it
  • its persistent volumes
  • its Secrets
  • its database and database user

Make sure you have a backup you can restore from before you continue.

Company in a Can admin. Apache-2.0.
